title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve releases results of Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR)
主要内容: The Federal Reserve Board completed its Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) for 34 bank holding companies. One firm was required to address capital planning weaknesses and resubmit its plan by the end of 2017. The review emphasized the importance of strong capital levels in helping banking organizations absorb losses and maintain lending capacity during stress. Governor Jerome H. Powell highlighted that the CC. The assessment included both quantitative and qualitative factors, with 13 major banks undergoing full review and 21 others only quantitative checks. The Fed may block capital distributions if concerns arise. The Federal Reserve did not object to the capital plans of several U.S. banks, including Ally Financial, Inc., American Express Company, and others. However, Capital One Financial Corporation was required to submit a new capital plan within six months due to weaknesses in its process. U.S. banks have significantly increased their capital since 2009, with the common equity capital ratio of 34 bank holding companies rising from 5.5% to 12.5% by Q1 2017, reflecting an increase of over $750 billion in common equity capital.
